## What the chronicles say [Record]

Nothing in the record.

## What really happened [Saga]

On the longest night by the drifted calendar (12 Dec 1449; the calendar has drifted twelve days from Kūčios; Praurimė's zenith halves Birutė's cost) [Žiežirba](../characters/flame_keeper.qmd) lights an ordinary driftwood fire on the Palanga shore, the first fire of his own in forty-four years (green-blue with salt). The Amber Queen speaks through the pebble for the last time and gives him his name.

## Consequences

Leads to [his death](ev_keeper_dies.qmd) in early March 1450.

## Dramatisation

Book V ch. 29 "Vardas prie Ugnies" (Birutė's frame voice; 12 Dec 1449).
